text: Are all women dishonest liars when it comes to relationships? Another crazy question. Hi Ilyas, I was just wondering if you could help me with something. I've been in my fair share of relationships in my life. Naturally, they have been getting better, but now I feel quite stuck for the girls I try to have relationships with always lie, even if it's about nothing. And to me, I see it as if you lie about something to me for no gain, you most definitely will do it for gains. But it's starting to feel impossible to find a girl who can just maintain honesty and truth. I've begun thinking it may just be something I have to accept about girls, yet I doubt I would be able to ever maintain a relationship if this is the fact. Of course, I don't want that to be true, but after so many, it feels silly to believe that isn't how it is. I hope to hear from you as this is really playing on my mind, and when I tried to speak to my friends about it, they also agreed so it may help more than just me. Thank you for your time, and I hope you have a blissful day. P.S. I tried to use punctuation, sorry if it isn't the best. Well, better than some other messages, but still, we got some work to do. Okay, so let me understand it. You are saying all the girls you have ever been in a relationship with always lie. So you think it is impossible to find a girl who can maintain honesty and truth. And I suppose when you talk about the lies, it is something non-trivial. For example, she told you she's going to have a coffee with a female friend, but turned out she went to a club. At least that's how I read it. Now, man, I have some bad news for you. What is the common denominator for all your relationships where all women are liars and dishonest? The common denominator for all of them is you. It is you who chose to be with all these women. And think about it. Are there women out there who are honest, truthful, great partners? Of course they are. Now we can argue about what is the percentage of women out there who can be great partners. Is it 1%, is it 5%, is it 10% or 50%? But for sure there are women like that. So the fact that all of the women you have been with turned out to be constant liars is on you, man. And here's the interesting thing. Probably before you even decided to be in a relationship, you had the period where you had dates where you were seeing each other. So you actually saw all of that behavior and you still decided to be in a relationship with those ladies. And now you are blaming all women because it is you who chose partners who are dishonest? In this case, you are not better than some of the ladies who say, oh, all men are jerks because all my exes were jerks. Well, maybe it is because you always chose to be with jerks. Same here. Maybe you chose to be with dishonest lying girls. So what it tells me is that you yourself still need to have a lot of work to do on yourself, on how you see the world, on how you choose a partner. So recipe here is simple. Learn to understand what kind of person is in front of you. And it's not that hard. You look at their actions. You simply look at what they say and how they behave towards you or other people. Normally, after a few dates, you can already know quite a bit about a person. So if you see that a girl is a liar or dishonest, just don't go into a relationship. And again, ask yourself, why is it the case that you keep ending up with women like this? Maybe the main reason is you yourself. Think about it.
